name: Ease-in and ease-out guidance
summary: Use acceleration and deceleration that support the intended motion without implying an unverified native control.
refusalConditions: the requested easing has no admitted emitter mapping
qualityChecks: motion starts and lands without a visible mechanical snap
failureModes: presenting conceptual easing as a live Final Cut control
safety: preserve the locked timing while changing only allowed treatment construction

riskGates.basis: Reference-only easing guidance has no emitter mapping.

validation.notes: Conceptual guidance only; no additional easing control is claimed.
